targets.title: Goal Conflict Encourages Work and Discourages Leisure
targets.evidence_quote: We chose to replicate Study 1a (N = 210) because it represented a simple test of both of the authors’ hypotheses.
targets.outcome_quote: On balance, then, these replications were not successful.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors give an explicit overall unsuccessful verdict, which governs despite directional evidence for the leisure effect and the original authors’ more favorable feedback.

reasoning: Two new MTurk samples retest Study 1a from one linked original paper. The post supplies the original title but does not print its authors, publication year, or DOI; these fields remain blank rather than inferred from the hyperlink or outside metadata.
